key_insight: Introduce on-policy adversarial flow distillation: train causal autoregressive student video models from black-box, prompt-conditioned teacher videos by matching the student's rollout transition flows to the teacher via an adversarial objective, avoiding the need for teacher scores or internals.
problem_solved: Distills high-quality autoregressive video teachers into causal students despite distribution mismatch (student rollouts vs teacher outputs), heterogeneous teacher architectures/schedules, and limited access to only completed, prompt-conditioned videos.
method: On-policy rollouts: let the causal student generate trajectories under its own sampling distribution to form training data that matches deployment conditions.

Adversarial flow matching: use an adversarial objective to align the transition "flow" (conditional next-frame/latent dynamics) between student rollouts and teacher-provided completed videos without requiring teacher scores or architecture access.
Prompt-conditioned supervision: condition the adversarial discriminator/matcher on prompts so the student learns to reproduce teacher-conditioned behaviors from final videos alone.
impact: Enables practical distillation of opaque, high-performing video generators into lightweight causal models suitable for streaming, long-horizon, and interactive use cases. Reduces dependency on teacher internals or score-based signals, making distillation feasible in real-world deployment scenarios.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: black-box teacher (completed videos only) feeding adversarial flow matcher and causal student producing on-policy rollouts (looped arrows to show self-generated distribution).
Timeline comparison: off-policy (teacher outputs) vs on-policy (student rollouts) highlighting distribution mismatch and where learning occurs.
Flow-field visualization: example transition flow vectors or attention maps showing alignment between student and teacher dynamics.
Performance chart: teacher vs distilled student on key metrics (fidelity, temporal coherence, rollout robustness) across horizon length.
paper_title: On-Policy Adversarial Flow Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation
paper_authors: Yang Luo, Shengju Qian, Xiaohang Tang, Zirui Zhu, Yong Liu
